_about: Public-domain A. B. Simpson (Albert Benjamin Simpson, 1843-1919, founder of the Christian and Missionary Alliance) for the Word Hoard: Days of Heaven upon Earth (Project Gutenberg, 1897) and 35 books from Internet Archive scans, 1888-1926, among them four volumes of Christ in the Bible, The Four-Fold Gospel, The Holy Spirit, The Gospel of Healing and two books of verse. Every Christian Publications (Harrisburg) printing is a post-1930 reprint and is left out. Divine healing teaching; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
